title: STS-8 Mission Highlights
keywords: PD NASA, Videos of films from NASA

transcript.text: There's a vehicle on the pad, the night of the launch, unfortunately you can't see the lightning in the rain.
As we depart our quarters heading out to the pad, once again it doesn't show, but it was raining cats and dogs.
And I think each of us in the crew were not real confident that we were going to get off.
Here's a picture in the cockpit before liftoff that's looking over Richard's shoulder.
And we got off a little bit late, but we did get to go.
And the three main engines started just fine. We were running very smoothly when it was a little bit of vibration in the cockpit.
The SRB's lit off and it became very bright, as you can see right here.
It was just like day in the cockpit. And all during first stage we didn't need lights in the cockpit.
The vibration was pretty much like other crews have explained in the cockpit.
When they were in first stage we were shaking around a little bit, but nothing you couldn't handle.
And from reports of people on the ground they got a pretty spectacular show.
